_comment: Structured extraction of the fee table on special-event-permit-application-with-fees.pdf, p.1. Mirrors the shape of the fee_schedules table in the project's data model. All amounts effective as of the form's last-updated marker (2026-03-10) unless a fee resolution says otherwise.
